Join the Paonia Literary Club for a thoughtful evening around The Dog Stars 🐕✨. . 

The Dog Stars is coming home.

Peter Heller’s novel is now a Ridley Scott-directed film and the story of Hig, surviving in a post-pandemic, apocalyptic Delta County, with his dog and a 1956 Cessna, will be showing at The Paradise October 23, 24, and 25. Tickets are $10 and available at The Paradise and online. Peter will be offering a talk-back after the show on the 23rd. Showtime 6:30. Paonia Literary Project will offer free, signed copies of The Dog Stars to the first 40 attendees at matinee showings on Saturday the 24th and Sunday the 25th.
